Name: (CP) Flame Replacements
Author: gentlyfloating
Description:
Ever thought the torch flames flickering was going to drive you crazy? Me too. So Flame Replacements was born.

Requires Content Patcher
Works with GMCM
Compatible with Alternate Textures for torches. AT is only able to change the bottom of the torch, so it is fully compatible with Flame Replacements.

Manifest.Name: FlameReplacements
Manifest.Description: Adds optional replacements for torch flames
Manifest.Author: Gentlyfloating
